products.title: Commissioned Oak Dining Table
products.description: A solid white oak dining table built to your dimensions with a breadboard end and a hand-planed top. Seats six to ten depending on specification.

products.title: Walnut Sideboard, Three Bay
products.description: A three-bay sideboard in American black walnut with hand-cut dovetailed drawers and soft-close runners.

products.title: Ash Spindle Back Chair
products.description: A steam-bent ash chair with a hand-shaped saddle seat. Priced individually; most customers order four to eight.

products.title: Oak Bed Frame, King
products.description: A king size bed frame in solid oak with a slatted base and bolt-through joinery for flat delivery and assembly.

products.title: Cherry Writing Desk
products.description: A writing desk in American cherry with a single full-width drawer and a cable channel routed into the rear rail.

products.title: Built-In Alcove Bookcase
products.description: A bookcase scribed to your alcove with adjustable shelves and a painted or oiled finish. Site survey included.

products.title: Elm Coffee Table
products.description: A low coffee table in figured elm with a waney edge left intact and stabilised. Each piece is unique to the board.

products.title: Oak Kitchen Island
products.description: A freestanding kitchen island with an end-grain butcher block top, two drawers and an open shelf. Built to your height.

pages.about: Alder & Bower is a furniture workshop of three makers. Every piece is built to commission from kiln-dried hardwood, by hand, in the order the commissions arrive. We do not hold stock and we do not batch-produce.
pages.refund_policy: Commissioned furniture is made to your specification and cannot be returned for change of mind. A 40% deposit is taken at order and is non-refundable once material is cut. Faults in workmanship are corrected or the piece is remade at no cost within five years.
pages.shipping_policy: Current lead time is 10-14 weeks from deposit to delivery, confirmed in writing at order. Delivery is by our own two-person team, who will place and assemble the piece in the room of your choice. Delivery is quoted by distance.
